title: First-order polynomial coordinates for a smooth augmented algebra
statement: Let $B$ be a commutative local ring and $C$ a smooth $B$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map] with a $B$-algebra augmentation $\varepsilon:C\to B$. Put $I=\ker\varepsilon$. There exist $n\in\mathbb N$ and a $B$-algebra map $f:B[X_1,\ldots,X_n]\to C$ such that, for the ideal $J=(X_1,\ldots,X_n)$, $f(J)\subseteq I$ and the induced map $B[X_1,\ldots,X_n]/J^2\to C/I^2$ is bijective. Rank zero is permitted. No Noetherian hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: The augmentation induces a B-algebra section B → C/I². Mathlib Algebra.retractionKerCotangentToTensorEquivSection converts this section to a C-linear retraction of the conormal map I/I² → B tensor[C] Ω[C/B]. Restrict scalars to B. Smoothness gives finite projective differentials, and base change gives a finite projective tensor module. Its retract I/I² is finite projective by Module.Finite.of_surjective and Module.Projective.of_split, hence finite free by Module.free_of_flat_of_isLocalRing.

Choose the finite basis indexed by Fin n of I/I², lift its elements to I using the proved surjectivity of Ideal.toCotangent, and evaluate polynomials at the lifts. Evaluation sends the variable ideal J into I and therefore J² into I². Every polynomial is congruent modulo J² to its constant term plus the sum of its degree-one monomials, by MvPolynomial.mem_pow_idealOfVars_iff' and the classification of monomials of degree zero and one.

For injectivity, if evaluation of a polynomial lies in I², the augmentation kills the evaluated linear part and detects its constant coefficient, so that coefficient is zero. Applying Ideal.toCotangent to the evaluated linear part and using basis independence forces all linear coefficients to vanish. The polynomial remainder lemma then puts the polynomial in J². For surjectivity, subtract the augmentation constant from a representative a in C to obtain an element of I, expand its cotangent class in the basis, and use the lifted linear combination. The discrepancy belongs to I² by Ideal.toCotangent_eq. Empty bases and sums cover n = 0. All chosen witnesses occur within a proved theorem; no definition chooses data from an unproved existence statement.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_augmented_firstOrder_polynomial_coordinates
    (B C : Type u) [CommRing B] [IsLocalRing B] [CommRing C] [Algebra B C]
    [Smooth B C] (ε : C →ₐ[B] B) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (f : MvPolynomial (Fin n) B →ₐ[B] C)
      (hf : MvPolynomial.idealOfVars (Fin n) B ≤
        (RingHom.ker ε.toRingHom).comap f.toRingHom),
      Function.Bijective (Ideal.quotientMapₐ ((RingHom.ker ε.toRingHom) ^ 2) f
        ((pow_le_pow_left' hf 2).trans (Ideal.le_comap_pow f.toRingHom 2)))
